main_text.p: &tum necesse est Verum de his commodius &c. explicatius cap. de cibis.
main_text.head: DE SECVNDO. Anautumnus, recte
main_text.p: Refponsio dicatur frigidus & ficcus, hiems frigida & hu- ad alterā mida &c. acuté difputat Galenus /. de temper. quaestio- cap.3.6 4. perstringens cos, qui vere esse calidi nem. & humidi temperamenti ideoque tempera- tum, autumnum frigidum & ficcum, ideoque intemperatum & morbiferum existimârunt, in qua etiam opinione bona phyficorum pars permansit ; persuasum sibi habens, ver, quia calidum & humidum, esse saluberrimum. Ve- rum ex Galeni iudicio res se longe habet ali- ter. Non enim aduertunt antiquos Atta- lensis Athenaei sectatores temperatam crafin, statumque præteremisse, eiusque plane non meminisse.

Sanitatis enim tuenda victum inuestigan- tes, calidiusque iusto corpus iubentes refrige- rare, vel frigidius calefacere, vel humidius fic- care, ficciusq; humectare, quid aliud intendat, quam temperatum quendam atq; mediocrem statum essicere ? Si igitur calidum & humi- dum excessus nomina funt, non potest verum esse, quod verfit in omnibus mediocre. Siau- tem iccirco humidum est & calidum, quod s- state humidius est, hieme vero calidius, quid obstat, quo minus id frigidum etiam ficcumq; sit, propterea quod sstate frigidius & hieme cali-

page.notes: Printed text is faint and partly cut by the binding at the left and right edges; several words in the body are doubtful and are not individually marked. The large dropped letter at the start of paragraphs and the italic words are reproduced as far as readable. The left and right margins contain faint marginal text that could not be read reliably and has been omitted. Some lines are heavily degraded and may contain errors in the Latin spelling; the transcription is best-effort and should be checked against the scan.
